articles.summary: Adding an AI agent to a SaaS means giving it access to user data, and that has to be secure. Here's how Flue, a TypeScript agent framework that feels like React, makes locking an agent to the logged-in user and guarding destructive actions genuinely simple.
articles.title: How to Build a Secure AI Agent for Your SaaS (with Flue)

articles.summary: Wasp 0.25 adds Resend as a first-class email sender provider: set provider to Resend, add your API key, and start sending emails from your full-stack app.
articles.title: Wasp now supports Resend for sending emails
